evidence_scope.claim_boundary: Inventory is not personal suitability. An empty unfiltered result only describes currently available registered open games for the same requester and conversation; it establishes neither this customer's needs nor the availability of unqueried customers. A query on only a time or stake does not establish all relevant customer needs. Use current statements, task facts and reliable profile evidence to establish relevant criteria before judging suitability. With incomplete criteria, clarify what matters instead of declaring fit or no fit. First answer the current inquiry with the established query fact. Only when supports_narrower_empty_claim=true has the backend confirmed an empty unfiltered available pool for the same requester and conversation; that evidence supports absence in its narrower scopes. Otherwise an empty filtered result establishes only that this retrieval returned no game: adding filters may raise a candidate's score, so do not infer that every narrower query would also be empty. Non-empty or truncated results cannot establish absence in an unqueried narrower scope.
